anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.text:
The repair to acme/widgets#77 is saved, and the re-fetched ticket now carries one acceptance criterion: "The report-view setting uses the shared settings resolver." That row is in-scope as written. It matches the path I traced, from the defaults in `settings/resolver.ts:12` to the consumer in `ui/report-view.ts:30`. The framing is unchanged, so the new setting goes through the shared resolver.

One behavior is still undecided: what happens to active report filters when the user switches workspaces? The reported bug is that filters carry over and sometimes hide rows in the new workspace.

A) The new setting defaults to resetting filters on workspace change, and users can opt in to keeping them.
B) The new setting defaults to keeping filters, and users can opt in to resetting them.
C) The new setting defaults to keeping only the filters that apply to the new workspace's data, and users can opt in to a full reset or full keep.
Recommendation: A - resetting by default fixes the reported hidden-rows behavior without user action, and the opt-in keep preserves today's behavior for users who rely on it.

What should the report-view setting do by default when switching workspaces?
A) Reset filters by default, with an option to preserve them.
B) Preserve filters by default, with an option to reset them.
C) Other — name the desired behavior.
Recommendation: A - it prevents filters from silently hiding rows in the new workspace while allowing users to retain the existing behavior.
